remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946.. .. No signature. Nothing on back.... Grey shingle with white shell at base and green leaf above center right." Part of series renumbered by O'Keeffe and Doris Bry in 1970. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication lists medium as 'Oil on board'. MFA Boston lists it as 'Oil on panel'. (Source: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by MFA Boston, 2025)

credit_line: Alfred Stieglitz Collection—Bequest of Georgia O'Keeffe
description: A bright green leaf extends along the upper third of the composition. Its smooth surface contrasts with the rough gray background that resembles rock. A jagged, narrow sliver of white background is visible running vertically along the lefthand side of the composition. At the bottom of the work, a white, open clamshell is partially visible.
title: Shell & Old Shingle III/Shell and Old Shingle No. 3
